goal: report/FINDINGS.md answers the question with every claim tied to a checked source, and lists what was not verified

steps.title: Write the question and sub-questions
steps.proof: notes/QUESTION.md states the question and lists the sub-questions to answer

steps.title: Collect sources on Claude Code and Codex
steps.proof: notes/sources-a.md has a URL and a quoted line for each of its sub-questions

steps.title: Collect sources on Gemini CLI
steps.proof: notes/sources-b.md has a URL and a quoted line for each of its sub-questions

steps.title: Write the draft report
steps.proof: report/draft.md answers each sub-question and every claim cites a URL from the notes

steps.title: Verify every claim against its source
steps.proof: notes/verification.md lists each claim as confirmed, corrected or unverified, with its source URL

steps.title: Revise the draft from the verification
steps.proof: Every claim marked corrected in notes/verification.md is changed in report/draft.md

steps.title: Publish FINDINGS.md
steps.proof: report/FINDINGS.md exists, matches the revised draft and ends with a Not verified section
